caption: The same truck unit feeds two paths. The 140-byte SMS path sends 3.36 kB per truck per day to a control room, 2.688 MB for the fleet; the 20 kB upload path sends 480 kB per truck to a cloud platform, 384 MB for the fleet — about 143 times more data.

spec.title: 800 trucks, two paths
spec.aria: A block diagram where one truck unit splits into two paths: a blue M2M path sending a 140-byte SMS hourly to a control room, 3.36 kB per truck and 2.688 MB for the fleet each day; and an orange IoT path uploading a 20 kB record to a cloud platform feeding apps, 480 kB per truck and 384 MB for the fleet each day, about 143 times more data.
